verdict.rationale: Recurly emits webhook notifications. The credit-invoice docs say each credit gets webhook notifications, and the Engage partner-integration docs describe connecting a Recurly account through webhooks to receive real-time subscription events. This evidence is indirect, though, and comes from feature pages rather than dedicated webhook documentation. Missing for 10: dedicated webhook docs (endpoint configuration, full event catalog, payload format, signature verification, retry/delivery guarantees), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
